meta.src:
schema: playbook/2
name: component_abssEn8eu88XgAP_0_playbook
title: component_abssEn8eu88XgAP_0_playbook
actions:
  Configuration:
    title: Configuration
    type: createVariables
    description: >
      Loads configuration settings including observable enrichment types and phishing email SLA hours from asset configurations.
    on-success:
    - Prepare_Fields: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    inputs:
    - name: Observable_Types_to_Enrich
      value:
        $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_Threat_Intelligence_Configuration.Observable_Types_to_Enrich
    - name: Phishing_Email_SLA_Hours
      value:
        $:ref: $assets.AI_SOC_General_Configuration.SLA_Hours.Phishing_Triage
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 1760e77a-9d09-40b4-b0c1-cce52ddf08cb
    outputSchemaReferenceId: d8321f13-87e3-49c3-8cdc-753a800f7456
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Prepare_Fields:
    meta: {}
    title: Prepare Fields
    type: transformation
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success:
    - Render_Email_HTML: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Extracts observable values from email data and checks if extended email fields are present in the input.
    transformations:
      extended_fields_exist:
        title: Extended Fields Exist
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: >-
            (
                $ext := inputs.Extended_Email_Fields;

                $count($keys($ext)) > 0 ? true : false ;
            )
          data:
            inputs:
              alert:
                $:ref: $inputs.alert
              Extended_Alert_Fields:
                $:ref: $inputs.Extended_Alert_Fields
              Extended_Email_Fields:
                $:ref: $inputs.Extended_Email_Fields
        actionType: jsonata
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
        next: authentication_details
      observables_value_array:
        title: Observables Value Array
        description: ""
        display:
          functions:
          - function: lookup
            inputs:
            - $:ref: $inputs.email.observables
            - observable_value
          - function: arrayForce
            inputs: []
          advancedView: false
        inputs:
          expression: $lookup(inputs.email.observables,'observable_value') ~> $arrayForce()
          data:
            inputs:
              email:
                observables:
                  $:ref: $inputs.email.observables
        actionType: jsonata
        next: extended_fields_exist
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
      authentication_details:
        title: Authentication Details
        description: ""
        display:
          functions: []
          advancedView: true
        inputs:
          expression: "inputs.email.email_headers[header_key=\"Authentication-Results\"].(\n    $val := header_value;\n    $capitalize := function($str) { $str ? $uppercase($substring($str, 0, 1)) & $substring($str, 1) : null };\n    \n    $extRes := function($regex) { \n        $match($val, $regex) ? $capitalize($match($val, $regex)[0].groups[0]) : null \n    };\n    $extRsn := function($regex) { \n        $match($val, $regex) ? $trim($match($val, $regex)[0].groups[0]) : null \n    };\n    \n    {\n        \"spf_result\": $extRes(/spf=([^\\s;]+)/i),\n        \"spf_reason\": $extRsn(/spf=[^\\s;]+\\s*([\\s\\S]*?)(?:;\\s*(?:dkim|dmarc)=|$)/i),\n        \"dkim_result\": $extRes(/dkim=([^\\s;]+)/i),\n        \"dkim_reason\": $extRsn(/dkim=[^\\s;]+\\s*([\\s\\S]*?)(?:;\\s*(?:spf|dmarc)=|$)/i),\n        \"dmarc_result\": $extRes(/dmarc=([^\\s;]+)/i),\n        \"dmarc_reason\": $extRsn(/dmarc=[^\\s;]+\\s*([\\s\\S]*?)(?:;\\s*(?:spf|dkim)=|$)/i)\n    }\n)"
          data:
            inputs:
              email:
                email_headers:
                  $:ref: $inputs.email.email_headers
        actionType: jsonata
        next: ""
        timeout: 0
        meta: {}
    entrypoint: observables_value_array
  If_Extended_Keys_Exist:
    title: If Extended Keys Exist
    type: conditional
    description: >
      Evaluates whether extended email fields are available to determine if additional record updates are needed.
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    conditions:
    - action: Upsert_CASE_Record_With_Extended_Fields
      condition:
        $:and:
        - - $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Fields.result.extended_fields_exist
          - $:eq: true
    else: ""
    inputSchemaReferenceId: bcd967b1-944b-4560-a911-262b7cc2cd6d
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
  Upsert_CASE_Record:
    meta: {}
    title: Upsert CASE Record
    type: recordAction
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success:
    - If_Extended_Keys_Exist: {}
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Creates or updates a CASE record with comprehensive phishing email details including headers, body, authentication checks, and observables.
    inputSchemaReferenceId: 8863c9fd-8c19-4b9c-99ac-89d70a84acd9
    inputs:
      applicationName: ""
      applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
      keyFieldKey: phishing-email-message-id
      keyFieldValue: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_message_id }'
      patchValues:
        signal-name: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_subject }'
        signal-type: '{ $:ref: $inputs.Signal_Type }'
        threat-intelligence-reference:
          $:ref: $inputs.Threat_Intelligence_Tracking_IDs
        knowledge-base-articles-reference:
          $:ref: $inputs.KB_Article_Tracking_IDs
        observables:
          $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Fields.result.observables_value_array
        organization: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_organization }'
        time-of-first-evidence: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_delivery_timestamp }'
        phishing-email-message-id: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_message_id }'
        phishing-email-subject: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_subject }'
        phishing-email-from: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_from_address }'
        phishing-email-to-addresses:
          $:ref: $inputs.email.email_to_addresses
        phishing-email-cc-addresses:
          $:ref: $inputs.email.email_cc_addresses
        phishing-email-reply-to-addresses:
          $:ref: $inputs.email.email_reply_to_addresses
        phishing-email-delivery-timestamp: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_delivery_timestamp }'
        phishing-email-text-body: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_text_body }'
        phishing-email-html-body: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_html_body }'
        phishing-email-headers: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_headers }'
        phishing-email-mime-parts: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_mime_parts }'
        phishing-email-sender-domain: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_sender_domain }'
        phishing-email-sender-ip-address: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_sender_ip }'
        phishing-email-return-path: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_return_path }'
        phishing-email-mta: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_mta }'
        phishing-email-raw: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.raw_email }'
        phishing-email-dmarc-check: '{ $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Fields.result.authentication_details.dmarc_result }'
        phishing-email-dmarc-results: '{ $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Fields.result.authentication_details.dmarc_reason }'
        phishing-email-spf-check: '{ $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Fields.result.authentication_details.spf_result }'
        phishing-email-spf-results: '{ $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Fields.result.authentication_details.spf_reason }'
        phishing-email-dkim-check: '{ $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Fields.result.authentication_details.dkim_result }'
        phishing-email-dkim-results: '{ $:ref: $actions.Prepare_Fields.result.authentication_details.dkim_reason }'
        signal-impacted-users:
          $:ref: $inputs.email.email_to_addresses
        sla-total-hours:
          $:ref: $variables.Phishing_Email_SLA_Hours
        signal-source: '{ $:ref: $inputs.Signal_Source }'
        phishing-email-body-image:
          $:ref: $actions.Render_Email_HTML.result.file
        severity: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.severity }'
      removeValues: {}
      appendValues: {}
      restrictions:
        users:
          operation: append
          value: []
        groups:
          operation: append
          value: []
    recordActionType: upsert
  Upsert_CASE_Record_With_Extended_Fields:
    meta: {}
    title: Upsert CASE Record With Extended Fields
    type: recordAction
    delay: 0
    pool: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete: []
    publish: {}
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    description: >
      Updates the CASE record with supplementary extended email fields provided in the component inputs.
    inputs:
      applicationName: ""
      applicationId: aGLUPEw5Z3dKNx0wk
      trackingId: "{ $:ref: $actions.Upsert_CASE_Record.result['tracking-id'] }"
      patchValues:
        $:ref: $inputs.Extended_Email_Fields
      removeValues: {}
      appendValues: {}
      restrictions:
        users:
          operation: append
          value: []
        groups:
          operation: append
          value: []
    recordActionType: patch
  Render_Email_HTML:
    title: Render Email HTML
    type: connector
    description: ""
    on-success: []
    on-failure: []
    on-complete:
    - Upsert_CASE_Record: {}
    publish: {}
    action: swimlane_render_html.render_html
    inputs:
      html_data: '{ $:ref: $inputs.email.email_html_body }'
    pool: $default
    testInputs: {}
    meta: {}
    delay: 0
    post: {}
    timeout: 0
    asset: ""
    environment: {}
meta: {}
description: ""
namespace: $default
entrypoints:
- Configuration
pool: ""
timeout: 0
publish:
  SIG_Tracking_ID: "{ $:ref: $actions.Upsert_CASE_Record.result['tracking-id'] }"
environment: {}
triggers: {}
